references.observed: Compressed blue body, dark palette-shaped upper-body patch with blue oval opening, yellow caudal wedge and dark borders, small mouth and yellow pectoral tips.

limitations: Original Paracanthurus hepatus visual study based on the inspected Mark Rosenstein photograph. The supplied generic Surgeonfish/Tang alias is retained; the two peduncle scalpels are represented folded. Fine dentition and microscopic scale detail are simplified and swimming is artist-tuned.
